name: Saint Andrew Corsini
history: A young Florentine of noble family whose wild youth ended when his mother told him that, before his birth, she had offered him to God and Our Lady. He became a Carmelite friar and later, much against his will, bishop of Fiesole, where he was known for his care of the poor, his gift as a peacemaker and his hidden penances.
life: Andrew was born into the powerful Corsini family. Tradition says that his mother dreamed she had given birth to a wolf that ran into a Carmelite church and became a lamb. As a young man he fell in with bad company, until his mother told him of her dream and her vow; he went to the Carmelite church to pray, and stayed. He was professed as a friar, studied abroad, and became a preacher and prior in Florence and Tuscany. When he was chosen as bishop of Fiesole he hid, the story goes, until he was found and persuaded to accept. As bishop he kept his religious rule, visited the poor, slept little and gave away his income. Pope Urban V sent him to make peace between warring factions at Bologna, and he succeeded. He died on the feast of the Epiphany and was canonised in 1629. A chapel in the Lateran basilica is dedicated to him.
prayerTo: Saint Andrew, your mother’s prayers brought you home, and God made a lamb of you. Pray for all mothers who weep for their children, and for young people who have lost their way. Pray for me, that I may turn back to God whenever I wander, and become a peacemaker where there is division. Amen.
penance: Pray today for a young person who has drifted from the faith, and do a quiet kindness for someone poor in your neighbourhood.
meditation: A mother’s faith turned a wolf into a lamb. For whom are you praying, and will you keep praying however long it takes?
prayer: O God, Who establish ever new examples of virtue in Your Church, grant that Your people may follow the footsteps of blessed Andrew, Your Confessor and Bishop, so that they may also obtain his reward. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
